name: Law of Crimes II (CrPC)
exam: AKNU Law of Crimes-II (Criminal Procedure Code, Juvenile Justice, Probation) exam
example: Section 154, which is now Section 173 of the Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita
example_te: Section 154 — ippudu Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita lo Section 173

episodes.t: The FIR That Could Not Be Refused
episodes.s: Lalita Kumari — criminal justice systems, Arts 14/20/21/22, features of the Code, definitions, FIR Sec 154-157
episodes.cover: Inquisitorial vs adversarial systems; Arts 14, 20, 21, 22; salient features of the 1973 Code; police-prosecution-courts-prisons; Sec 2 definitions (investigation, inquiry, cognizable, bailable, complaint, charge, summons and warrant cases, discharge vs acquittal); FIR Sec 154-157 and Lalita Kumari's mandatory-registration rule; Bhajan Lal; H.N. Rishbud; e-FIR and zero FIR under BNSS

episodes.s: D.K. Basu & Arnesh Kumar — arrest Sec 41-60, 70-80, rights of the arrested, preventive powers 149-153
episodes.cover: Sec 41 necessity test and 41A notice; 41B-41D; 46(4) women; 50, 50A, 54-57, 55A; warrants 70-81; preventive powers 149-153 and Sec 151; Art 22 rights; D.K. Basu's eleven requirements; Joginder Kumar; Arnesh Kumar; Prabir Purkayastha written grounds; Paramvir Singh Saini CCTV

episodes.s: Nandini Satpathy — Sec 160-162 statements, 164 confessions, 167 remand, 172-176 diary, report, inquest
episodes.cover: Sec 160 who may be summoned; 161 answers except self-incrimination; 162 use only for contradiction with 145/157 IEA (Tahsildar Singh); 164 Magistrate's confession with warning, reflection time, 164(5A); 167 remand, fifteen days police custody (Anupam Kulkarni), default bail (Rakesh Kumar Paul), BNSS 187 change; 172 case diary; 173 report and 173(8) further investigation (Vinay Tyagi); 174-176 inquest and 176(1A)

episodes.s: Pooran Mal — search and seizure Sec 91-103, 165-166B, proclamation and attachment 82-89
episodes.cover: Sec 91 summons to produce (not to the accused); 93 search warrant; 100 witnesses, seizure list, copy; 102 seizure and bank accounts (Tapas Neogy); 165 search without warrant with recorded reasons; 166A-166B letters rogatory; 82-89 proclamation, proclaimed offender, attachment, claims; Pooran Mal on illegally obtained evidence; Balbir Singh; Lavesh on anticipatory bail for proclaimed offenders; BNSS videography and trial in absentia

episodes.s: Bhajan Lal — jurisdiction 177-189, cognizance 190-194, bars 195-199, complaints 200-210, Sec 482
episodes.cover: Sec 177 ordinary rule and exceptions 178-188; cognizance meaning (R.R. Chari) and Sec 190-193; 195 (Iqbal Singh Marwah), 196, 197 sanction (Matajog Dobey), 198-199; complaints 200-203, Sec 156(3) vs 202 (Devarapalli Lakshminarayana Reddy), 204 process (Pepsi Foods, Adalat Prasad), 207-210 commitment; Bhajan Lal's seven categories for quashing under Sec 482

episodes.s: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia — bail Sec 436-450, anticipatory bail 438, undertrials 436A
episodes.cover: Sec 436 bailable as of right and indigent presumption; 436A half-sentence release and BNSS 479 one-third rule; 437 non-bailable factors, provisos for women, sick, under sixteen, 437(6); 439 High Court and Sessions powers and cancellation (Dolat Ram); 438 anticipatory bail, 2005 factors, bars, Sibbia, Sushila Aggarwal; 440-450 bonds and sureties (Moti Ram); Hussainara Khatoon; Sanjay Chandra; Satender Kumar Antil

episodes.s: Shah Bano — maintenance Sec 125-128 and the 1986 Act, security 106-124, unlawful assembly, Sec 133-144, 145-148
episodes.cover: Sec 125 claimants, conditions, disqualifications, interim maintenance, enforcement; 126-128; Shah Bano, the 1986 Act, Danial Latifi, Mohd Abdul Samad 2024; Rajnesh v Neha; security for peace and good behaviour 106-124 (Madhu Limaye); unlawful assemblies 129-132; public nuisance 133-143 (Ratlam Municipality); Sec 144 limits and Anuradha Bhasin; disputes about immovable property 145-148

episodes.s: Nanavati — fair trial, charge 211-224, sessions, warrant, summons and summary trials, plea bargaining
episodes.cover: Fair trial elements: presumption of innocence, silence, speedy trial (Hussainara Khatoon, Antulay), legal aid, Zahira Sheikh; charge 211-217 and alteration 216; joinder rule 218 and exceptions 219-223; 464; sessions trial 225-235 with discharge (Prafulla Kumar Samal), Sec 313, Sec 235(2) hearing on sentence (Santa Singh); warrant cases 238-250; summons cases 251-259; summary trials 260-265; plea bargaining 265A-265L; the end of jury trial

episodes.s: Maqbool Hussain — Sec 300 double jeopardy, compounding 320, withdrawal 321, pardon 306-308, unsound mind, limitation 467-473, irregularities
episodes.cover: Art 20(2) and Sec 300 with five exceptions (Maqbool Hussain, S.L. Apte, Kolla Veera Raghav Rao); compounding Sec 320 and quashing on settlement (Gian Singh); withdrawal Sec 321 (Sheonandan Paswan, K. Ajith); tender of pardon 306-308 and approver corroboration (Suresh Chandra Bahri); unsound mind 328-339; limitation 467-473 (Sarah Mathew); irregular proceedings 460-466, 479; evidence in trials 272-283

episodes.s: Bachan Singh — judgment 353-365, death confirmation 366-371, appeals 372-394, revision 395-405, transfer, execution and remission 413-435
episodes.cover: Sec 353-354 contents and special reasons; 357, 357A compensation; 362 no alteration; confirmation of death 366-371; appeals 372 (victim's appeal, Kodagali), 374, 377, 378 (Chandrappa), 386, 389 bail pending appeal; reference 395; revision 397-401 with 397(2) interlocutory bar (Madhu Limaye) and 401(3); transfer 406-407 (Zahira Sheikh); execution 413-435, 427 concurrent, 428 set-off, 432-433 remission and commutation, 433A (Maru Ram), Sriharan; Art 72/161; Bachan Singh, Machhi Singh, Shatrughan Chauhan

episodes.t: The Boy Who Was Not Tried as a Man
episodes.s: Nirbhaya juvenile & Pratap Singh — juvenile justice history, IPC 82-83, JJ Acts 1986, 2000, 2015
episodes.cover: Doli incapax, parens patriae, CRC and Beijing Rules; IPC 82-83; CrPC 27; JJ Act 1986 (delinquent vs neglected juvenile, boards and courts, homes), JJ Act 2000 (age eighteen, JJB and CWC, no jail, 2006 amendment date-of-offence rule), JJ Act 2015 (definitions, petty/serious/heinous, Board, Sec 12 bail, Sec 15 preliminary assessment, Children's Court, Sec 21, CWC, homes, adoption, offences against children, 2021 amendment); age determination Sec 94; Sheela Barse, Pratap Singh, Salil Bali, Shilpa Mittal, Barun Chandra Thakur

episodes.s: Ramji Missar — Probation of Offenders Act 1958, Sec 360-361, parole, Malimath Committee, 2005/2008 amendments, BNSS
episodes.cover: Concept and development of probation; Probation of Offenders Act Sec 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 11, 12, 13-14; Sec 360-361 CrPC; Ramji Missar, Isher Das, Jugal Kishore Prasad; parole and furlough (Sunil Fulchand Shah, Asfaq) and the probation-parole distinction; Malimath Committee 2003 recommendations; 2005 amendment (plea bargaining, 436A, 50A, 176(1A)), 2008 amendment (41, 41A-D, victim, 357A, 372 proviso), 2013 amendment; BNSS 2023 key changes
